annotations.text:
Grid anatomy
• outer 1px border + 16px radius on the card
• header band (surface-2), 40px, 11px uppercase labels, sort arrow
• 48px rows, 1px row + column dividers (border-subtle)
• hover = --aq-hover, selected = --aq-selected + accent checkbox
• selection bar replaces toolbar actions when rows are picked
• status as pill + dot, never colour alone
• row actions in a fixed right column, 32px hit targets
• footer: range, rows-per-page, numbered pager

Dashboard
• header = title + context line + time window pill
• KPI tiles: label, 32px value, one line of context; the alerting tile gets a tinted outline
• fleet health as a segmented bar with legend, not a bare progress line
• chart: recessive grid, alarm threshold as dashed rule, 2px lines, legend chips, range pills
• alarms table uses the same grid anatomy as the entity pages
• all values are --aq-* tokens already in styles.scss; no new colours
